author: Scout
change_details: Bounded process-local witnesses avoid repeated semantic validation of identical frozen text snapshots after full dictionary and canonical-hash validation.
Every call reads and fingerprints current snapshot bytes and retains forecast/index/cycle/session/mapping/supersession checks.
Changed text is fully revalidated; binary and unusual representations retain the original validator.
Regression coverage preserves expiry, manual controls, capacity, order identities, encoding behavior and bounded concurrency.
limitations: First reads, changed bytes and cache eviction still require full semantic validation.
Offline results do not establish loaded runtime or full-cycle latency recovery.
Main preparation is blocked until the reviewed parent source becomes an ancestor of main; resume the same Completion-Record.
Private account state, credentials, raw data, fitted models, recipe identities and operating logs are excluded.

main_integration.reason: origin/main does not descend from reviewed source base

peer_applicability: Shared processing repair applies to either PC. Preserve private direction-policy changes, recipes, symbols, data and operating bindings. Peer installation is not established.
runtime_implications: Local forecast source is imported at startup. The reviewed repair was installed locally for a later human manual reload; affected runtime behavior remains unconfirmed. Publication performs no trader controls.
summary: Avoid repeated frozen snapshot decoding during local order authorization
